PendingPublication.description:
Recoverable record written before a persistent deployment starts.

A pending record means the named versions may already be live. Pina freezes
them until the exact deployment is completed into a receipt.

cluster.description:
Cluster label used to reconcile the in-flight deployment.

Not part of the immutable receipt: it exists only on this transient local
record so `pina deploy` can report and match the pending target.

executableSha256.description: SHA-256 of the program executable the deployment ships.

rpcUrl.description: Credential-free RPC endpoint used by the deployment plan.

versions.description: The pinned schema history the in-flight deployment may make live.

PublicationReceipt.description:
One successful persistent deployment receipt.

The program a receipt deployed is the manifest's `programId`: the ledger
belongs to the manifest beside it and never names another program.

abandoned.description:
Marks a receipt created by reconciling an ambiguous deployment as
abandoned. The pinned versions stay frozen because the deployment may
still have gone live.

executableSha256.description: SHA-256 of the deployed program executable.

rpcUrl.description: Credential-free RPC endpoint used by the deployment plan.

versions.description: The pinned schema history of every contract the deployment made live.

PublishedContract.description:
One contract's published state as frozen by a receipt.

Entry `n` pins version `n`, and the pins cover every version up to and
including the highest one made live, so that version is the position of the
last pin rather than a stored number. Serialized as the bare list of pins.

PublishedSchema.description: One published schema pinned by a receipt.

schemaSha256.description: Content hash of the published schema.

transitionSha256.description: Hash of the adjacent transition implementation entering this schema.

description:
Local record of the versions that have been made persistent.

Receipts are appended in deployment order. The file lives in version
control, which is what keeps it append-only: a hash chain over the receipts
could be recomputed by anyone able to edit them, so none is stored.

abiVersion.description: The ABI document version that wrote this ledger.
